title: Runs: log?after, graphs
what:
- GET /hub/runs/<rid>/log?after=N: ndjson from `eidolon --config <run cfg> log --json --after N <log>` through titles::run, cached on (mtime, len, after). An unchanged log gives 200 with an empty body and starts no child.
- GET /hub/runs/graphs and /hub/runs/graphs/<g>: the raw graph JSON (at most 1 MiB) and its sha256, for the new-run form only.
Health moved to R1a.
tests:
tests/runs_log.rs:
- log?after returns only ids above N, in order, while the fake is still sleeping (with a timeout guard)
- an unchanged log causes no extra fake call (FAKE_LOG count)
- graphs refuse names outside the list
live_check: fake perch on PORT=48107: curl log?after while a fake run steps.
risk: Each changed poll starts `eidolon log`, which rewrites <config>/eidolon/system, at most once a second while a run is active. The page's lane keeps it to one in flight.
